title: Skipass Madness After Christmas
summary: Arcade downhill skiing across six Roccaraso-inspired pistes.
description: An original Mountain Madness-inspired downhill challenge featuring Roccaraso piste names and landscapes, slalom gates, trees, rocks, local scoring and network ghosts. Tracker music is confined to title, attract, winning and game-over screens; gameplay uses stereo event effects only.
controls: Left/Right steer; Up/Down speed; A carve; Start pause/return
